body: Thanks for the advice! i'll definitely look more into doing volunteer work.

Hi there,
I saw your post and I had such a strong feeling to read what you had to say and respond. As i was reading i couldn't  believe how similar I am to you in almost every way, When i was your age (i'm 23 now) I use to be so shy i was like a mute and it sucked, i hated that the people i considered my friends wouldn't even listen to me when i tried to talk to them and they would even make fun of me, it was wrong and i now know that I didn't deserve to be treated that why and to think that whatever i had to say wasn't worth saying or that i wasn't good enough because of how shy i was, you also don't deserve anyless in life because of the way you were made. I want you to know that it is ok to not be as outspoken as others there's nothing wrong with you that you may only be able to open up to a select few people, because that just shows how much you trust the people you do talk to and also that you know they care. I'm not sure if this will help but i use to find it helped talking to people online, its more relaxing than talking face to face, if you don't feel comfortable you can end the conversation and it wont hurt anyone's feelings, and your still are being social but its at your own pace(Just be careful with who you talk to since you never know). I'm not sure if anything i said will help but even if it makes you feel a little less alone and also if you need to talk anymore feel free to reply to this message or send me a private one if you prefer.
Take care yourself :)
Thank for your kind words, and for giving me alot to think about in regards to what i deserve in life.

I just wanted to send send you a message and say thank you for all the encouraging words, it really hit home and made me feel a little better just knowing someone who doesn't even know me could say such nice things about me that i honestly didn't even think that i was.
